_note: The sibling of onboarding-achievement-step-complete — same component, the
`isLastStep` branch. Read that recipe's note for the probe rationale and
the blue-500 refusal; what is specific to this board:
COPY, board wins: "All done!" -> "All done", "You're all set!" ->
"You're all set" (no exclamation marks on either), and the sentence under
the title is the board's — "You've finished every getting-started step. Go
build something great." The apostrophe is the typographic one: THIS board
types it ASCII, board 296:2030 types the same words with U+2019, and the
rest of the editor's copy is typographic. Two boards disagree about a
character, so neither settles it and the house style holds.
GLYPH: the board draws a white ★ on the disc. The code drew 🎉, and a
colour emoji ignores `color` — it painted multicoloured confetti on a
green disc, at 20px where the board says 18. Board wins on both.
NOT JOINED, and why:
430:2385 countdown-fill, 430:2388 badge, 430:2394 btn/primary — all
`--color/success` (#0E9F6E). REFUSED ON CONTRAST, and unlike the blue-500
case this one was already shipping: white 14px on #0E9F6E is 3.39:1
(AA wants 4.5) and the 3px fill on its #E5E7EB track is 2.73:1 (1.4.11
wants 3). The fill is now `--bk-success-text` (#057A55) — 5.36:1 and
4.33:1 — which is the token set's own readable green, not a new colour.
The board and the code were BOTH wrong here; the board copied the code.
430:2384 countdown-track — the 380-vs-378 border-box trap, same as the
sibling board.
430:2393 all-done desc — `leading-[1.5]` states a ratio, the browser
reports 19.5px, and the harness's length normaliser reads bare `1.5` as
1.5px. Unjoinable by construction, not undone: `tw:leading-[1.5]` is in
the code.

countdown-FILL (430:2385) is not a target at all, joined or measured: its width is wall-clock (100%->0 over 4s), so any number read from it says when the browser looked, not what the code renders. Measured it once anyway and it cost a run — playwright's locator.screenshot on the 0-width frame aborted the whole screenshot pass. The TRACK is static and stays.

badge-glyph (430:2389) is measured, not joined: the board sizes it 18, and the DS type scale has no 18 (11/12/13/14/16/20/24) with `gate:design-debt-ratchet` locked at zero off-scale sizes. Snapped to 16 — the same call InspectorEmptyState.tsx made when board 1175:4847 asked for 10 against the scale's 11 floor — which still moves in the board's direction, since 20 is what shipped. The glyph's white fill and `normal` leading are unchanged and were passing; only the size is unjoinable.

HARNESS NOTE, worth passing on: this board's spec `copy[]` held only ["ALL DONE", "Done"] until the title and the sentence were read straight out of raw-figma. extract.mjs's copy scraper misses a text node written as a JSX expression container — `

{`You're all set`}

` — which is how Figma exports any string containing an apostrophe. So check-board-copy reported the two most important lines on this board as "product renders, no board draws". They are on the board; the extractor could not see them.
